question: HGCA is related to LKGE in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, BKOM is related to FOSQ. To which of the following is NSJD related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914456ecd02a295fcb6a97049dfda1145c674dab9f03e8a7de5db8403c4b7657.png]

**HGCA: LKGE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4223bf9d5a7ac501dbb2364c633776914d3cfd1f1ad095cb1e6aa133c63929f4.png] 

**BKOM: FOSQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9d020efeed87e5f42971f9c9a469eb6978f561f1abfcdd769164065ac19a9cd.png]

**NSJD: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd36a4747249d9fcba305023cffdbc66b2e500d2f57c3f85cbb9e026f8ca73ad.png]
